title: 第3章 第一案：518儿童被拐案（3）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

晚上七点。

李安国脸色阴沉的走进会议室。

距离念念所说的八点，只剩一个小时。

要是再找不到人贩子藏匿孩子的地点。

孩子就要变成残废了！

“李队，你真相信那孩子说的话吗？”

“是啊李队，我们都追了一天了，硬是连人贩子的车尾气都没吸到，这也太诡异了！就好像是他们在故意溜我们一样！”

“那孩子……不会是卧底吧？”

李安国捶桌，怒视说话的警员。

警员连忙低头。

一个三岁小孩当卧底，确实很不科学。

但这孩子实在诡异！

任曼妮推开门，从门缝里挤进脑袋：“李队，念念说她知道人贩子藏在哪了。”

“李队！我们监控组也发现了人贩子踪迹！”

“在这！”

“在这！”

念念稚嫩的声音和监控组组员的声音同时响起。

一大一小两只手，指向地图完全相反的两个方向。

赵家村VS龙湖别墅。

任曼妮：“李队，根据以往经验，我觉得赵家村概率更大。

儿童不受控，一旦哭闹，肯定会引起周围人注意。

但赵家村属于农村。

人口流动性弱，隐蔽性强。

曾经就发生过一起儿童拐卖案，就是乡镇人员团伙作案。”

念念眼睛锃亮。

崇拜的看着任曼妮。

漂亮姐姐好厉害！

和哥哥姐姐叔叔阿姨们说的话一模一样！

【这剧情怎么翻拍的和案子不太一样啊？】

【管它呢！我就喜欢看改编！最好能把结局改成大圆满！】

【就是！现实已经够苦了，节目翻拍，改成另一个结局不是更好？】

【有意思，好想快进，我就想知道李队到底会不会相信这小孩！】

“李队！我们十一区已经二十多年没有出现过人贩了！

全国都知道，我们十一区的人，是最讨厌人贩的。

但凡发现有人伤害孩子，他都不可能走出十一区！

所以我断定，这伙人贩绝对来自外地。

赵家村村民宗族意识强且极度排外，绝不可能收留外地人。

独栋、无人居住的烂尾楼别墅，是他们最好的选择。

而且我们通过天眼系统，切实看到他们开车进入别墅区！”

监控组组员据理力争。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

7 p.m.

Li Anguo walked into the conference room with a gloomy face.

There is only one hour left before the eight o'clock that Nian Nian said.

If we can no longer find the place where the traffickers hide their children.

The child is going to be disabled!

"Captain Li, do you really believe what that kid said?"

"Yes, Captain Li, we have been chasing for a whole day, but we didn't even inhale the traffickers' car exhaust. This is so weird! It's like they are trying to escape us on purpose!"

"That kid...can't be an undercover agent, right?"

Li Anguo pounded the table and glared at the police officer who spoke.

The police officer quickly lowered his head.

It is indeed unscientific for a three-year-old child to serve as an undercover agent.

But this kid is really weird!

Ren Manni opened the door and squeezed her head through the crack: "Captain Li, Niannian said she knew where the traffickers were hiding."

"Team Li! Our surveillance team also discovered traces of human traffickers!"

"Here!"

"Here!"

Nian Nian's childish voice and the voices of the surveillance team members sounded at the same time.

Two hands, one big and one small, point in completely opposite directions on the map.

Zhaojiacun VS Longhu Villa.

Ren Manni: "Team Li, based on past experience, I think Zhaojiacun has a higher probability.

Children are uncontrolled and will definitely attract the attention of those around them if they cry.

But Zhaojiacun is a rural area.

Population mobility is weak and concealment is strong.

There was once a child abduction case, which was committed by a gang of township personnel."

Nian Nian's eyes were bright.

Looking at Ren Manni with admiration.

Beautiful sister is so amazing!

Exactly what my brothers, sisters, uncles and aunts said!

[Why is the plot of this remake so different from the case?】

【What the hell!I just love watching the adaptation!It would be best to change the ending to a happy ending!】

【that is!Reality is hard enough, wouldn't it be better to remake the show with another ending?】

[Interesting, I really want to fast forward, I just want to know if Captain Li will believe this kid!】

"Captain Li! We haven't had a human trafficker in District 11 for more than 20 years!

The whole country knows that we in District 11 hate human traffickers the most.

Whenever he finds someone harming a child, he cannot leave District 11!

So I concluded that this group of traffickers definitely came from other places.

The villagers in Zhaojia Village have strong clan consciousness and are extremely xenophobic, and they will never accept outsiders.

Single-family, uninhabited unfinished villas are their best choice.

And through the Sky Eye system, we actually saw them driving into the villa area!"

The members of the monitoring team argued hard.
